testcase.name: Scenario: Toggle Modify from Show Panels while its additional commands are open: tmp/oblikovati-ribbon-relocated.RcZVDl/panel-visibility-snapshot/checkout/features/application/ribbon-panel-visibility/ribbon-panel-visibility.feature:737:3
testcase.system-out: Scenario: Toggle Modify from Show Panels while its additional commands are open ✔ Given a part is active with the full 3D Model ribbon docked at the top ✔ And the Modify additional command area is open ✔ When the user opens Show Panels from the active tab context menu ✔ Then Modify is checked in the panel list ✔ When the user selects Modify ✔ Then the menu closes ✔ And the Modify panel and its additional command area are hidden ✔ When the user reopens Show Panels from the active tab context menu ✔ Then Modify is unchecked ✔ When the user selects Modify ✔ Then the menu closes ✔ And the main Modify panel is visible ✔ And the additional command area remains closed
